en: A black-and-white vintage photograph of a stone building with ornate Gothic windows and a balcony. The structure features pointed arches and detailed stonework, characteristic of Venetian Gothic architecture. Several people in period clothing are standing or sitting in front of the building, suggesting the photo was taken in the early 20th century or late 19th century. There is no visible modern infrastructure in the image.
